name: Automotive
short_description: Develop practical skills in vehicle servicing, mechanical maintenance, diagnostics and repairs.
description: Explore nationally recognised automotive qualifications designed to develop practical skills in light vehicle servicing, mechanical maintenance, vehicle diagnostics and automotive repairs.
overview: Build your career in Australia's automotive industry with nationally recognised qualifications. Develop technical knowledge and practical skills in vehicle servicing, mechanical maintenance, fault diagnosis and repairs. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) may help recognise your existing automotive experience and workplace skills towards a formal qualification.
highlights: Gain practical automotive knowledge, mechanical skills and diagnostic expertise for career opportunities in vehicle servicing, maintenance and automotive repair workshops.

name: Business & Leadership
short_description: Develop professional skills in business operations, administration and leadership management.
description: Explore business qualifications designed to develop professional knowledge and practical skills in business operations, workplace administration, team leadership and management.
overview: Advance your career in Australia's business sector with nationally recognised qualifications. Develop essential skills in business operations, workplace communication, administration, team leadership and organisational management. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) may help recognise your existing workplace experience and management skills towards a formal qualification.
highlights: Build professional skills in business administration, workplace operations, team leadership and management for career opportunities across different business environments.

name: Beauty, Hair & Personal Care
short_description: Build practical skills in beauty therapy, hairdressing, barbering, makeup and nail technology.
description: Explore industry-focused qualifications in beauty services, beauty therapy, hairdressing, barbering, makeup artistry, nail technology and salon management.
overview: Build your career in Australia's beauty and personal care industry with nationally recognised qualifications. Develop practical skills in beauty treatments, skincare, makeup application, nail technology, hairdressing, barbering and salon operations. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) may help recognise your existing industry experience and practical skills towards a formal qualification.
highlights: Develop practical beauty, hairdressing, barbering, makeup, nail technology and salon management skills for career opportunities across salons, beauty clinics and the personal care industry.
